nameZh: IPIP情绪导向决策9题（研究译稿）
attribution: Barchard (2001), as attributed by the official IPIP key; do not claim a complete emotional-intelligence battery.

items.en: Listen to my feelings when making important decisions.
items.zh: 做重要决定时，我会听从自己的感受。

items.en: Base my goals in life on inspiration, rather than logic.
items.zh: 我设定人生目标时，依据的是灵感，而不是逻辑。

items.en: Plan my life based on how I feel.
items.zh: 我会根据自己的感受规划生活。

items.en: Believe emotions give direction to life.
items.zh: 我相信情绪能为生活指引方向。

items.en: Listen to my heart rather than my brain.
items.zh: 相比理性思考，我更听从内心的感受。
我会按照逻辑规划自己的生活。

items.en: Believe important decisions should be based on logical reasoning.
items.zh: 我认为重要决定应当以逻辑推理为依据。

items.en: Listen to my brain rather than my heart.
items.zh: 相比内心感受，我更听从理性思考。

items.en: Make decisions based on facts, not feelings.
items.zh: 我依据事实而不是感受做决定。

reliability.interpretation: Official English-source group coefficients, women N=432 and men N=317; not evidence of Chinese reliability, individual accuracy or normative thresholds.

construct: Self-reported preference for feelings rather than logical reasoning in decision-making; not decision quality, impulsivity, psychological flexibility, emotion regulation or emotional-intelligence ability.

feedback.summary: 做决定时，你更容易先问“我有什么感受”，还是“事实和理由是什么”？这份回答描述你通常偏向哪种参考方式，不评判哪种方式更聪明。
feedback.direction: 计分方向越高，表示你越倾向依据感受做决定；较低则更倾向依据事实与逻辑。两者都可能提供有用信息，结果不是决策能力的好坏标签。
feedback.reflection: 想一想最近一次选择：当时有哪些事实？又有哪些感受或期待？它们是互相支持，还是指向不同方向？
feedback.action: 下次面对一个日常小选择，可以分别写下“已知事实”和“我的感受”，再看看是否还有需要了解的信息。无需强迫自己只选一种依据。
feedback.limits: 不用于判断冲动性、情绪调节能力或临床风险。该中文工作译稿尚待审核与验证，没有可用的项目常模或分界值。

construct: 感受与逻辑的决策偏好
population: 成人研究使用边界；非中文效度声明

versionNote: Current official key as accessed 2026-10-25; not the old 10-item form.
family: IPIP scales measuring seven components potentially related to emotional intelligence (Barchard, 2001); this isolated component is not a full emotional-intelligence test and is not another proprietary instrument.
